description: This is a test source file for the HomePageDao class, containing PHPUnit test cases that verify the functionality of data access methods related to home pages and module default pages within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: HomePageDaoTest
classes.description: Test class for HomePageDao, containing test cases for retrieving home pages and module default pages in priority order, based on user roles.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares test environment by truncating relevant tables and populating fixtures, then initializes the HomePageDao instance.

methods.name: testGetHomePagesInPriorityOrderOneRole
methods.description: Tests retrieval of home pages ordered by priority for a single user role.

methods.name: testGetHomePagesInPriorityOrderMultipleRole
methods.description: Tests retrieval of home pages ordered by priority for multiple user roles.

methods.name: testGetHomePagesInPriorityOrderNoMatches
methods.description: Tests behavior when no home pages match the given user role.

methods.name: testGetHomePagesInPriorityNoUserRoles
methods.description: Tests behavior when no user roles are provided.

methods.name: compareHomePages
methods.description: Helper method to compare expected and actual home page objects.

methods.name: testGetModuleDefaultPagesInPriorityOrderOneRole
methods.description: Tests retrieval of module default pages ordered by priority for a single user role.

methods.name: testGetModuleDefaultPagesInPriorityOrderMultipleRole
methods.description: Tests retrieval of module default pages ordered by priority for multiple user roles.

methods.name: testGetModuleDefaultPagesInPriorityOrderNoMatches
methods.description: Tests behavior when no module default pages match the given roles.

methods.name: testGetModuleDefaultPagesInPriorityNoUserRoles
methods.description: Tests behavior when no user roles are provided for module default pages.

methods.name: compareModuleDefaultPages
methods.description: Helper method to compare expected and actual module default page objects.
